wheelspirit.how: A wheel that has turned on its own for sixty years. Its prayers stream out of it in a spiral.

lion.name: Guardian Lion
lion.how: A stone lion beside the doorway. It wakes when you pass and pounces, and stone turns half of every hit.

bellspirit.name: Bell Spirit
bellspirit.how: A bell that rings itself. Each peal shoves you away from it, toward the edge if you are careless.

crow.name: Temple Crow
crow.how: Crows that roost under the eaves, which are now under the floor. They come in a black cloud.

crane.name: Golden Crane
crane.how: Rare: a golden crane. It flies off, and drops treasure when caught.

master.name: The Gardener-Master
master.how: The abbot's oldest student, floating above his raked garden. He blinks from place to place, rings the garden bell to shove you away, and at half health calls his monks out of meditation.
master.callMsg: The Master opens his eyes. 'Students. Wake.'

monastery.arrive: Steps hang out over the sky. Above you the monastery stands the right way up. Below you, hanging from it, is the rest of it, upside down.
monastery.healMsg: Tea, still warm, in a room where nobody has been for sixty years. You drink it. (Checkpoint)
monastery.shrineMsg: You sit before the shrine and for a moment you weigh nothing at all. Your shots lighten, and the monastery opens its eyes.

names.secret: Under the Floor (which is the ceiling)

id.grammar: Two monasteries, one above the other. The upper half stands upright on the mountain; the lower half hangs beneath it upside down. Between them is open sky, crossed only by turning stairs. The route crosses that sky more than once, and the antechamber is in the upturned half. Many rooms are cloisters, walks around an open well that drops into the sky.
id.start: The Hanging Steps: a flight of stairs that ends in the air, a temple lantern, and a view of the monastery going on below you, inverted.
id.landmark: The sky well at the centre of every cloister, and the band of open sky between the two monasteries: you always know which half you are in.
id.feature: Inversion. Halfway across every turning stair the world flips: in the upturned monastery up and down are swapped, for you, and stones fall upward. Loose flagstones drop away into the sky.
id.ante: The Bell Stair: the great bell hangs upward from the floor, and Abbot Ossian floats beneath it, unmoored.
traps: Some flagstones drop away into the sky a moment after you step on them; you'll find yourself back at the edge.
In the cloisters the chimes ring and a gust pushes you toward the well.
In the upturned half, loose stones fall upward from the floor where their shadows show.
Every peal shoves you away, toward the sky if you're careless.
In the upturned half up is down. It's a trap in its own right.
secrets: In an upturned room the ceiling is the old floor, and the cellar trapdoor is up there. Walk into the trapdoor painted on the upper wall.
Three wheels, each marked with the way it turns. Walk all the way round a wheel in that direction to spin it; spin all three.
The novice who was here the morning the monastery let go.

lore: The novices' sandals are nailed to the ceiling. Or the floor. It's hard to tell.
'When the bell turned over, so did we.'
A prayer written a thousand times, smaller each time, until it's just a dot.
The koi in the pond swim in the air above it.
mutations: Golden Monks are common, and so is treasure

keeper.name: Dial Keeper
keeper.how: Advances behind a levelled spear and thrusts a lance of light along it.

sandthrower.name: Sand Acolyte
sandthrower.how: Throws handfuls of sand that slow you where they land.

sundisc.name: Sun Disc
sundisc.how: Throws a fan of sun-lances while the sun is on it. When the dial's shadow passes over it, it goes dark and can't fight.

shade.name: Shade
shade.how: A shadow that stood up. Inside the dial's shadow it is hard to hurt; caught in full sun it burns twice as easily.

timekeeper.name: Timekeeper
timekeeper.how: Fires clock hands that slow you down for a moment if they hit.

colossus.name: Sun Colossus
colossus.how: A stone giant with a sun for a face. Stone turns aside much of every hit, and it slams a ring of sand around itself.

sandmite.name: Sand Mite
sandmite.how: Boils up out of the sand pits in swarms.

goldsun.name: Golden Sun
goldsun.how: Rare: a little golden sun that rolls away from you. It drops treasure when caught.

astronomer.name: The High Astronomer
astronomer.how: Keeps the observatory's great dial. He turns a ring of sun-lances around himself, fires clock hands that slow you, and at half health calls the sand mites up through the floor.
astronomer.callMsg: The Astronomer strikes the floor with his staff and the sand boils.

sanctum.arrive: You come in at dawn, from the east. Ahead the sanctum opens around a sundial as big as a courtyard, and its shadow is moving.
sanctum.healMsg: A pool that holds the midday sky. You drink, and for a moment it is always noon. (Checkpoint)
sanctum.shrineMsg: You stand in the shrine's ring of light at noon. Your shots blaze like it, and every shade in the sanctum turns your way.

id.grammar: Radial. Eight wedge-shaped hour chambers stand in a ring around a sundial as big as a courtyard, like the hours on its face. You come in at dawn in the east and leave by the shadow gate in the west. Each chamber opens onto its neighbours, and onto the dial through an hour gate that only opens while the dial's shadow lies across that chamber.
id.start: The Dawn Court, east of the sanctum: an hourglass lying on its side with its sand running sideways, a sun brazier, and the dial's shadow sweeping toward you.
id.landmark: The Great Dial in the middle, with its gnomon. Its shadow turns across the whole sanctum, chamber by chamber, and you can see it from anywhere.
id.feature: The turning shadow. It opens the hour gates to the dial as it passes, silences sun discs and sun-lances where it falls, strengthens shades inside it and leaves them exposed outside it.
id.ante: The Shadow Gate: the westernmost point of the sanctum, where the shadow ends and Aion keeps the still hour.
traps: Lenses in the walls fire beams while the sun is on their chamber, and stop in shadow.
Lines of solid shadow sweep the floor in rows.
In sunlit chambers a focused spot of sunlight finds you.
On the dial a burning line of light turns opposite the shadow.
Sand pits slow you and breed mites.
secrets: A seam of gold in the outer wall of one chamber. It opens only while the dial's shadow lies across that chamber.
Three seals set in the face of the dial. Stand on each one as the shadow crosses it.
His notes on the hour that never ends.

lore: The sundial here casts its shadow the wrong way.
'An hour was stolen from this place. Everyone here is still waiting for it.'
An astronomer's chart with a gap in it. Something used to be there.
The sand in the fallen hourglass is falling upward.
mutations: Golden Gnomons are common, and so is treasure

wisp.name: Star Wisp
wisp.how: Loose starlight. Wisps drift at you in loose swarms across the gaps between the stars.

comet.name: Comet
comet.how: Hangs back, then streaks straight at you, leaving a burning tail across the chart.

starcaster.name: Star-Caster
starcaster.how: Throws starrows in threes from the far side of the gap.

astrologer.name: Astrologer
astrologer.how: Turns a slow ring of stars around himself and calls wisps down out of the sky.

asteroid.name: Asteroid
asteroid.how: Rolls slowly toward you. Rock turns aside much of every hit, and when it breaks it breaks into fragments that keep coming.

fragment.name: Asteroid Fragment
fragment.how: A broken piece of asteroid, still rolling.

nova.name: Nova
nova.how: Swells as it comes at you and bursts into a ring of stars when it dies. Kill it at a distance.

lens.name: Star Lens
lens.how: A lens on a tripod. It takes a long aim and fires a single astral lance across the whole gap.

moon.name: Lost Moon
moon.how: Rare: a tiny moon that wandered off its orbit. It flees, and drops treasure when caught.

hunter.name: The Hunter
hunter.how: A constellation that stood up off the chart. It looses fans of starrows, dashes across the gap between stars, and at half health calls its hounds, the wisps, down from the sky.
hunter.callMsg: The Hunter raises its bow to the sky. The stars come down as hounds.

atlas.arrive: There is no floor here, only the night, and a page of stars. Lines of starlight run from one star to the next. Where no line has been drawn yet, there is nothing to stand on.
atlas.healMsg: A star in a quiet orbit. Its light is warm. (Checkpoint)
atlas.shrineMsg: You find the North Star. Your shots point true, and every eye in the sky turns toward you.

names.secret: Off the Edge of the Map

id.grammar: A network shaped like constellations. Four constellations, drawn from a set of figures (the Hunter, the Crown, the Serpent, the Bear, the Scales), sit across the page from west to east. Each star is a platform; lines of starlight join the stars of a figure. Between one constellation and the next the lines are not drawn yet.
id.start: The Open Page: a scrap of parchment floating in the night, a captive star, and the first line of starlight running off into the dark.
id.landmark: The constellations themselves. Each one is a recognisable figure, and every star in it lights up on the chart when you have set foot on it.
id.feature: Charting. Step on every star of a constellation and it is complete: the lines of starlight to the next constellation are drawn, and only then can you cross. There is nothing to stand on between the lines.
id.ante: The Map's Last Page: the edge of the chart, where Vael has been hunting since the sky kept her.
traps: Some lines of starlight burn along their length in pulses.
Comets leave burning trails across the stars.
Lenses snipe across the gap from a long way off.
Novae burst into rings of stars when they die.
Between the lines there is only the night.
secrets: Off the edge of the map
A lone star with no line drawn to it. There is a line, unlit; dust drifts along it. Walk the dust.
Five pedestals in a figure. Step from star to star along the lines, using each line once, until the whole figure is drawn.
The last navigator who tried to chart the Atlas.

lore: The atlas has a page for every star. One page has been torn out.
'She drew the stars, and the stars moved to match her drawings.'
A navigator's log: 'Followed the map. The map followed back.'
There's a star here with your name written next to it, in fresh ink.
mutations: The void is darker than usual
Little Moons are common, and so is treasure

pawn.name: Pawn Soldier
pawn.how: Marches in a line with the others and rushes forward a step when you come within reach.

knight.name: Knight
knight.how: Moves like a chess knight: it waits, then leaps in an L on the beat and lands with a crash. Don't be where it lands.

bishop.name: Bishop
bishop.how: Glides only on the diagonals, on the beat, and fires along them.

rook.name: Rook
rook.how: Slides in straight lines on the beat and fires down the line it stops in.

crossbow.name: Crossbowman
crossbow.how: Shoots from the walls and arrow slits, taking careful aim.

armor.name: Empty Armour
armor.how: Stands in its alcove until you pass, then turns its head and follows. Steel turns half of every hit.

catapult.name: Catapult
catapult.how: Lobs stones over the battlements wherever you're standing.

rat.name: Dungeon Rat
rat.how: Pours out of the dungeons in a squeaking swarm.

queen.name: Black Queen
queen.how: The strongest piece on the board. She blinks anywhere in the room and throws a fan of decrees.

goldpawn.name: Golden Pawn
goldpawn.how: Rare: a pawn of solid gold. It runs, and drops treasure when caught.

champion.name: The Champion
champion.how: Morvane's champion. He charges with his lance, slams a ring of shade around himself, and at half health calls his pawns into line.
champion.callMsg: The Champion raises his lance. 'Pawns, to me!'

keep.arrive: A dead hill, a black moat, and a drawbridge that is down, which is worse than if it were up. Beyond the gatehouse, the castle is waiting for you in its squares.
keep.healMsg: A fire still burns in the guard tower's hearth. Somebody left the stew on. (Checkpoint)
keep.shrineMsg: You kneel in the castle chapel. Your shots take an oath, and every piece on the board turns to face you.

id.grammar: A concentric fortress. A moat and drawbridge on the west, a gatehouse, then the outer bailey: yards north, south and west of the inner curtain. Corner towers stand at the angles of the curtain wall, joined by wall-walks along its top. The inner gate is shut by a portcullis, and its winch is in a far tower: you climb onto the walls, walk them, wind the winch, and come back down to go in. Inside are the inner ward, the great hall and the champion before the throne room.
id.start: The Drawbridge: the approach on the far side of the moat, black water below, the drawbridge already down across it.
id.landmark: The keep in the middle of the castle, whose inner curtain every yard looks onto, and the portcullis in it that stays shut until you find the winch.
id.feature: Defence. The castle is built to be held: arrow slits and catapults cover the yards, murder holes cover the gatehouse, portcullises drop behind you, and its soldiers are chess pieces that move on the beat as pieces move.
id.ante: The Throne Room Doors: a chessboard floor running up to the doors where King Morvane sits on his hollow throne.
traps: Spears drop through the gatehouse ceiling in rows.
Slits in the curtain wall shoot into the yards.
Catapults on the walls lob stones where you stand.
In some yards the portcullis drops behind you until the defenders are dead.
The water is deep and black and you can't swim in it.
Knights, bishops and rooks move on the beat; knights crash down where they land.
secrets: Morvane had the crest scratched from every banner in the castle except one, the one over the door he meant to escape by. Walk into the wall behind the intact banner.
Gold squares on a chessboard floor. Step on them as a knight moves, each one a knight's move from the last.
A history of the castle that explains the banners.

lore: A game of chess, left unfinished. Every white piece has been knocked over.
'The king plays one game. It has lasted three hundred years.'
A royal decree: 'All guests shall stay. Forever.'
The portraits in this hall have all had their eyes painted over.
mutations: Black Queens are common, and so is treasure

scarecrow.name: Scarecrow
scarecrow.how: Stands still on its pole until you pass; then its pumpkin head turns and it spits a spread of burning seeds.

seedspitter.name: Seed Spitter
seedspitter.how: A pumpkin that grew a mouth. It sits in the furrows and spits seeds at you three at a time.

crowcaller.name: Crow-Caller
crowcaller.how: Keeps his distance and whistles up crows out of the corn.

crow.name: Crow
crow.how: Comes out of the corn in black flocks.

jack.name: Jack
jack.how: A jack-o'-lantern that hops after you. When it bursts it spills burning pulp across the ground.

gourd.name: Watching Gourd
gourd.how: Lies in the pumpkin rows like any other gourd until you walk by. Then it opens an eye and rolls at you.

farmer.name: Hollow Farmer
farmer.how: Comes at you with a pitchfork and jabs a line of tines along it.

balegolem.name: Bale Golem
balegolem.how: A walking hay bale bound with twine. Straw soaks up much of every hit, and it slams a ring of chaff around itself.

beetle.name: Crop Beetle
beetle.how: Swarms out of the furrows and clicks at your ankles.

goldgourd.name: Golden Gourd
goldgourd.how: Rare: a golden gourd that rolls away from you. It drops treasure when caught.

harvester.name: The Harvester
harvester.how: The Pumpkin Lord's reaper. Its scythe sweeps a wide arc of seeds around it, it lunges down the rows, and at half health it calls up the jacks.
harvester.callMsg: The Harvester lifts its lantern-heart. Jacks come hopping out of the rows.

patch.arrive: The gate is crooked and the hedges are taller than you. Somewhere in the rows, a carved lantern flickers on as if it heard you.
patch.healMsg: The farmhouse porch. A rocking chair, still rocking. You sit a while. (Checkpoint)
patch.shrineMsg: You leave a gourd at the harvest shrine. Your shots grow fat and orange, and every pumpkin in the patch turns to look.

id.grammar: A maze. Hedges divide the whole patch into a maze of narrow rows with loops in it, and the farm's buildings and fields sit inside it: the farmhouse at the crooked gate, pumpkin fields, a lantern field, a barnyard, and the barn at the far end. The sheds of the farmyard stand in a row along the bottom, each down its own short lane.
id.start: The Crooked Gate: a farmhouse yard inside the hedges, a sagging fence, dead corn, and the first carved lantern lighting itself.
id.landmark: The lanterns. A carved lantern stands at many junctions of the maze, and each one lights as you pass it, so the lit ones show you where you've been.
id.feature: Growth. Thin patches in the hedges can be cut through as shortcuts, but they grow back after a while. Gourds lie dormant in the rows until you pass, and the patch is dark.
id.ante: The Lord's Field: the last field, where Lord Gourdrick has grown too big for the barn.
traps: Vines snap up out of the furrows in rows and hold you.
Pumpkins hidden in the hedges fire seeds across the rows.
A hedge you cut through grows back once you're gone.
The gourds in the rows wake when you walk past.
secrets: The farmer's rule: dig where the crows circle. Crows wheel over one dead end of the farmyard lanes; walk into it.
Four cold lanterns in the lantern field. Light them all before the first one goes out.
The farmer's almanac, and its last entry.

lore: The scarecrows face inward, toward the house.
'Plant a seed, grow a gourd. Plant a farmer, grow a lord.'
A prize ribbon for the biggest pumpkin. Its date is next autumn.
Every lantern here was carved with the same face, and it's smiling wider each year.
mutations: Crows fill the sky over every field
Golden Gourds are common, and so is treasure

stagehand.name: Stagehand
stagehand.how: Works the flies. It comes at you with a wrench, and drops sandbags on you from the rigging.

cardsharp.name: Card Sharp
cardsharp.how: Fans five playing cards at you, then shuffles off to a new angle.

knifethrower.name: Knife-Thrower
knifethrower.how: Throws knives in a fast line that follows where you were standing.

rabbit.name: Rabbit
rabbit.how: Rabbits come out of every hat in the theatre, and keep coming.

assistant.name: Magician's Assistant
assistant.how: Circles you at arm's length, tossing roses that curve in toward you.

cannonball.name: Human Cannonball
cannonball.how: Crouches, takes aim, and launches itself at you, very fast and in a dead straight line.

strongman.name: Strongman
strongman.how: Muscle soaks up much of every hit. He brings the barbell down in a ring of shock.

balloon.name: Balloon Animal
balloon.how: Floats slowly toward you and pops into a ring of streamers.

goldcard.name: Golden Card
goldcard.how: Rare: a golden card that walks off on its corners. It drops treasure when caught.

ringmaster.name: The Ringmaster
ringmaster.how: Runs the big top. His whip cracks a line of ribbons at you, he throws cards in rings, and at half health he pulls rabbits out of his hat by the dozen.
ringmaster.callMsg: 'And now!' The Ringmaster sweeps off his hat. Rabbits pour out of it.

stage.arrive: You come in by the stage door. It's dark backstage, the ropes creak overhead, and from somewhere out front comes the murmur of an audience that should not be there.
stage.healMsg: The green room. Somebody left tea and a mirror ringed with bulbs. You sit and get your breath back. (Checkpoint)
stage.shrineMsg: You take a bow at the shrine of applause, and the house roars. Your shots dazzle, and every act in the theatre wants you on stage.

id.grammar: Four stages in a row, each a house of seats facing a raised stage. They don't open onto each other: every stage is reached from the passages behind it, the fly gallery above or the space under the boards, and those passages only run between some pairs of stages, so the route goes out onto a stage and back off it into the other passage. Dressing rooms hang off the passages; the Ringmaster's ring is at the far end.
id.start: The Stage Door: a dark corridor of ropes and sandbags, a rail of costumes, chalk marks on the floor, and the murmur of an audience.
id.landmark: The stages. Each has a proscenium, a house of red seats and a spotlight that roams the boards; the magician's cabinet stands on one of them.
id.feature: The show. Walk out onto a stage and the curtain rises: the doors shut and the performers come on in acts, wave after wave, until the curtain call. Standing in the spotlight makes your shots land harder. Trapdoors drop you under the stage.
id.ante: Behind the Curtain: the wings of the last stage, where Mirabeau is waiting to make you disappear.
traps: Trapdoors on the stages spring open in rows; you drop into the passages under the boards.
Stagehands drop sandbags from the rigging where their shadows fall.
Knife-thrower lines cut across the wings.
Once an act starts the doors stay shut until the curtain call.
secrets: The magician's cabinet on one stage never opens, until the act on that stage is over. For the finale it opens, and you can step in.
A card table. One card is shown face up, then the cards are shuffled face down. Keep your eye on it and step on it.
What the last star of the Velvet Stage left on her mirror.

lore: A playbill. Tonight: 'The Vanishing Audience.' Every seat is still empty.
'The best trick? Making them think they can leave.'
A cabinet with three doors. Two are locked from the inside.
The applause from the empty theatre starts when you walk in.
mutations: Golden Aces are common, and so is treasure

soldier.name: Folded Soldier
soldier.how: A paper samurai, all hard creases. It closes in and lunges with a paper blade.

dartfolder.name: Dart Folder
dartfolder.how: Folds darts and throws them three at a time; they bank in flight.

crane.name: Paper Crane
crane.how: Cranes come in flocks, a thousand of them if you let them.

brush.name: Brush Spirit
brush.how: Paints a line of ink across your path as it goes. The ink slows anyone who steps in it.

lantern.name: Loose Lantern
lantern.how: A paper lantern that floats free and throws out a ring of burning petals.

frog.name: Origami Frog
frog.how: Hops at you in long bounds.

tiger.name: Paper Tiger
tiger.how: Huge, roaring and all bluster: its roar shoves you back, and it pounces. It tears easily for something so big.

blot.name: Ink Blot
blot.how: Swims in the ink stream and climbs out after you. Hit it and it splits into droplets.

drop.name: Ink Droplet
drop.how: A splash of ink that keeps coming.

goldcrane.name: Golden Crane
goldcrane.how: Rare: the thousandth crane, folded from gold leaf. It flies off, and drops treasure when caught.

dragon.name: The Scroll Dragon
dragon.how: A dragon painted along a scroll, unrolled and loose. It circles, fans paper darts, breathes rings of petals, and at half health folds a flock of cranes out of itself.
dragon.callMsg: The dragon's scroll unrolls further. A flock of cranes folds itself out of the paper.

paper.arrive: You walk under a torii folded from a single sheet. The garden beyond is paper, every leaf and stone, and a stream of black ink runs through it under the moon.
paper.healMsg: A paper tea house. The tea is real. (Checkpoint)
paper.shrineMsg: You add a crane to the shrine's thousand. Your shots fold sharp as blades, and every paper thing in the garden turns its head.

id.grammar: A garden of paper chambers on both banks of an ink stream, joined by zig-zag paths folded like an accordion and paper bridges over the ink. The whole garden has two folds. Touch a paper crane and it refolds: some paths open and others close, and certain chambers change shape, a paper wall folding up through the middle of one, another opening out.
id.start: The Torii of Folded Paper: a gate folded from one sheet, a stone lantern, paper petals on the path.
id.landmark: The ink stream winding through the whole garden, with the moon reflected in it.
id.feature: Folding. Every chamber has a crane on a post; touching one refolds the whole garden. Paths and chambers change with the fold, and you choose when.
id.ante: The Pagoda Steps: a paper pagoda, and Orrigan, the thousandth crane, at the top.
traps: Paper edges fold up out of the floor in rows, sharp as knives.
The ink stream slows you; brush spirits paint ink across your path.
Refold the garden in the wrong place and the way back closes behind you.
Loose lanterns throw rings of burning petals.
Ink blots split when you hit them.
secrets: A door painted on a paper wall, in dry ink. Wade in the ink stream and touch the painting while your feet are still wet; ink makes drawings real.
Three cranes and three paper flaps. Each crane folds two of the flaps. Fold until the picture on the flaps is whole.
Notes from whoever folded nine hundred and ninety-nine cranes.

lore: A thousand cranes on a string. The thousandth one is still unfolded.
'Every fold is a wish. Every crease is a cost.'
A sheet of paper with a garden drawn on it. You're standing in it.
The ink in the stream is still wet, and it's writing something.
mutations: Ink blots split into more blots
Golden Cranes are common, and so is treasure
